observations: 'can .' produced no useful detections across the tested proxy images.
'package .' behaves too broadly and fires even on machinery-only imagery.
Combined prompts can suppress detections that appear when classes are queried separately.
Compound grounded phrases such as 'box package' can occur and need downstream handling.
text_threshold had no effect at 0.20/0.25/0.30 with single-word class names; it filters tokens mapping back to a phrase, so it becomes relevant with multi-word classes.
